description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location on Terminal Avenue in Nanaimo, a major arterial road near the BC Ferries terminal that sees significant through-traffic from cyclists traveling between Vancouver Island destinations. Outdoor seating is available, making it a viable rest stop. As part of the global Starbucks chain, it serves the full range of espresso drinks, teas, and packaged food items.
